title: Des Moines Register, "In Armed Forces" enlistment list (2 November 1962)
citation: "In Armed Forces," Des Moines Register, Friday 2 November 1962, p. 23. Twenty-five enlistments reported by the Des Moines recruiting stations; the ARMY list includes "Ronald E. Totosz, 21, of 1211 Merle Hay Road" (Des Moines). newspapers.com image 129134885; permanent clipping 203981003.
notes: The only item in print anywhere that records Ron Totosz’s military service, and the anchor of the identification. A standard three-year RA enlistment from November 1962 runs to November 1965, bracketing Larry’s September 1964 – September 1965 tour and matching his own separation on 30 November 1965. It establishes Army service, age and Des Moines address; it does NOT place him in Vietnam or in Larry’s unit, which is why the identification stands at strongly-supported rather than confirmed. Found via the newspapers.com search index, on a five-day trial; the clipping was saved because clippings stay publicly viewable after the trial ends.
